summary: Six of six seats succeeded. Gemini and GLM approved; Claude, Codex, Qwen and Kimi asked for revision. Four concerns reached two supporters: the temporal refusal is default-mode only, RP1 lacks an offline oracle, LH1-LH2 leave inputs bound to the packaged fixture, and D-12 is not anchored to its home. Qwen received only PROJECT.md inline and could not read the linked outlines.

agreed_concerns.title: The temporal-model refusal exists only in the default PyRel export, not under --rules lqp
agreed_concerns.summary: IR3, D3 and RP4 expect checking.orm.json to reach a temporal-model refusal in both modes. export/emit.py:36 refuses temporal models only in render_pyrel; the --rules lqp route has no such refusal and stops at the anchored constraint instead.

agreed_concerns.title: RP1's pass/fail require criterion has no offline enforcing oracle
agreed_concerns.summary: RP1 requires a duplicate (work, passage) population to fail the generated require, but the lqp program is compile-only offline and local DuckDB does not enforce require, while live RelationalAI runs are opt-in.

agreed_concerns.title: LH1-LH2 do not lift the binding of reading inputs to the packaged saved responses
agreed_concerns.summary: replay() already takes a folder; what blocks a host is ReadingInputs, which requires the saved responses.json and its pin and loads the packaged vocabulary. The LH criteria do not exercise a caller corpus and model with live responses.

agreed_concerns.title: D-12 is not tied to the document that defines it
agreed_concerns.summary: The roadmap row and maintenance note gate the fix on D-12 without naming its one home, provenance-and-modality.md, or the evolution-contract restatement that option (a) must keep in step.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make D3 and the IR3/RP4 temporal criteria mode-specific
prioritized_fixes.action: State per export mode what checking.orm.json does: default mode reaches the emit.py:36 refusal; under --rules lqp either record that date arithmetic lowers and expect export once RP2 lands, or add a named temporal refusal by owner ruling. Re-argue D2 accordingly.

prioritized_fixes.title: Bring fact-scoped value constraints into scope or drop the quantity fixture from RP4
prioritized_fixes.action: Add value-constraint support to the rules programs as a phase, or remove quantity_fixture/time.orm.yaml from RP4 and name the refusal it keeps; say which mode RP3's 'keeps exporting' means.

prioritized_fixes.title: Give RP1 an executable oracle
prioritized_fixes.action: State RP1's population criterion against the duckdb program's denial rows offline, keep lqp as compile check plus a named opt-in live run, and cite :882 beside :855 with a top-level test.

prioritized_fixes.title: Restate LH1-LH2 around the input binding
prioritized_fixes.action: Make LH1-LH2 remove the producer-pin and saved-roster coupling (reading.py:75, :113) and the packaged vocabulary load, and add a criterion with a caller corpus and model whose live responses are captured and replayed. Say the host-scale corpus and budget run stays carried with an owner.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name what detects a stale include in IR3, or drop the predicate
prioritized_fixes.action: Add the mechanism and a criterion that changes one include and observes the refusal, or remove 'a changed include makes the export stale'.

prioritized_fixes.title: Anchor D-12 to its home
prioritized_fixes.action: Name provenance-and-modality.md (Evolve admission, D-12) as the statement option (a) updates, evolution-contract.md:279-280 as the restatement, and link it from the roadmap row.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make the ordering and dependency statements agree
prioritized_fixes.action: Use one overlap statement for milestones 1 and 2 in PROJECT.md and the pyrel outline, record IR3 as RP4's start condition, say RP4 does not use LH interfaces, and say whether row 0 runs in parallel with the milestones while its ruling is pending.

prioritized_fixes.title: Link the roadmap's premises and earlier planned work
prioritized_fixes.action: Link the release-0.4.0 close and the guarded-rule-authoring GA1 record, note that the roadmap supersedes the 0.1.0 current-status line, and state the status of earlier planned sections (model-growth-guardrails and the literature outlines) relative to row 0.

prioritized_fixes.title: Map phases to issue requests
prioritized_fixes.action: In each outline's scope section, map every phase to the issue request it discharges and state the four #214 items.
